title: Governing Well in the Algorithmic Age: The Foundations of Digital Statecraft
abstract: arXiv:2607.18483v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The digital substrate - data, algorithms, infrastructure, platforms, applications - is being governed without adequate conceptual foundations. The ability and legitimacy required to govern this substrate, and to govern with it, are simultaneously misaligned, contested, and structurally absent. We introduce digital statecraft as the organising concept for this emerging field, arguing that 'digital' reconstitutes the statecraft question rather than merely extending its domain. The concept operates on two dimensions - statecraft over digital systems, concerning the authority and capacity of the state in relation to the digital substrate itself, and statecraft with digital systems, concerning the deployment of algorithmic tools as instruments of governing authority. translated_title: 算法时代的良治：数字治国术的基础
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2607.18483v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：数字基础设施——数据、算法、基础设施、平台、应用程序——正在缺乏充分概念基础的情况下被治理。治理这一基础设施所需的能动性和合法性，以及借助它进行治理的能动性和合法性，同时处于错位、争议和结构性缺失的状态。我们引入“数字治国术”作为这一新兴领域的组织概念，认为“数字”重构了治国术问题，而非仅仅扩展了其领域。这一概念在两个维度上运作——对数字系统的治国术，涉及国家相对于数字基础设施本身的权威和能力；以及借助数字系统的治国术，涉及将算法工具部署为治理权威的手段。它基于两个根本要求，即技术连贯性和合法权威，这两者之间存在真正的张力。我们推导出数字治国术的十项原则。
tldr: 本文提出“数字治国术”作为核心概念，强调数字技术从根本上重构了国家治理问题，而非简单扩展其范围，并确立了技术连贯性与合法权威这两大基础要求之间的张力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "digital statecraft" as a core concept, arguing that digital technology fundamentally reconstitutes the question of state governance rather than merely extending its domain, while establishing the tension between technical coherence and legitimate authority as foundational requirements.
